items.source: Run ClusterCommandExecutor.ClusterCommandCallback on all reachable master nodes.
items.translation: 在所有可达的主节点上运行 ClusterCommandExecutor.ClusterCommandCallback。

items.source: Run ClusterCommandExecutor.MultiKeyClusterCommandCallback with on a curated set of nodes serving one or more keys.
items.translation: 在针对一个或多个键的精选节点集合上运行 ClusterCommandExecutor.MultiKeyClusterCommandCallback。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。
